Courts Award Death Sentences in Child Rape and Murder Cases

Multiple Indian courts have recently handed down severe sentences, including death penalties and lengthy prison terms, in cases involving the rape and murder of minors. These judgments, often delivered by special fast-track or POCSO courts, have been issued within months or a few years of the crimes. The sentences aim to provide justice for the victims and their families, reflecting the gravity of the offenses.
